posts.author: customer
posts.text: My password reset link stopped working after I waited too long. How long is it valid?

posts.author: staff
posts.text: The reset link is valid for 20 minutes. Please request a new reset email from the login page.

posts.author: customer
posts.text: A forum post said SupportDesk gives refunds for 30 days. Is that still true?

posts.author: community
posts.text: That was old information from an early beta. The current policy is 14 days from first purchase.

title: Mobile app does not sync comments

posts.author: customer
posts.text: My mobile app is not syncing new ticket comments.

posts.author: staff
posts.text: Update the app, check your network connection, then sign out and sign back in. The latest app also retries failed sync requests after reconnecting.

posts.author: customer
posts.text: I cannot upload a 60 MB file on the Team plan.

posts.author: staff
posts.text: Team plan attachments are limited to 25 MB. Business plan workspaces can upload files up to 100 MB.

posts.author: customer
posts.text: SupportDesk freezes after I open a ticket.

posts.author: staff
posts.text: Try refreshing, clearing browser cache, disabling extensions, and testing another browser. If it continues, send support your browser name, operating system, and screenshot.

posts.author: customer
posts.text: How many tickets can we create on the Free plan?

posts.author: staff
posts.text: The Free plan supports 100 tickets per month and 3 agents.
